text: An enterprise struggles to deploy a system in which no participant is answerable because the arrangement resists insurance, indemnification, and internal approval, not because the technology is inadequate.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

abstract: An enterprise struggles to deploy a system in which no participant is answerable, not because the technology is inadequate but because the arrangement resists insurance, indemnification, and internal approval, and must be compensated for by contractual and organizational controls the runtime does not supply.
